}}{{recipe}}

'''Chupaquesos''' ("suck cheese") are a cheesy dish invented by Howard Tayler in his webcomic, Schlock Mercenary.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Saturday 6 September 2003 |url=https://www.schlockmercenary.com/2003-09-06 |access-date=2023-04-25 |website=www.schlockmercenary.com |language=en}}</ref> The basic idea is to fry cheese until it reaches a rubbery consistency, then cover that rubbery layer with cheese and toppings, then fold it into a tube.  
==Ingredients==
*About 3 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] (85 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) shredded "shell" cheese (e.g. [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|cheddar]])
*About 1 oz (28 g) shredded "filler" cheese (e.g. [[Cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|parmesan]], [[Cookbook:Monterey Jack Cheese|Monterey Jack]])
*Example toppings:
**[[Cookbook:Bacon|Bacon]]
**Chopped cold cuts
**Banana peppers
**[[Cookbook:Chili Pepper|Chili peppers]]
**Marinated [[Cookbook:Mushroom|mushrooms]]
**Marinara sauce

==Procedure==
#In a medium-large [[Cookbook:Non-stick|non-stick]] or cast-iron [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]], sprinkle the "shell" cheese evenly. It will melt and bubble, and eventually form a layer of cheese.  
#Once the underside is orange or brown colored, flip it over.
#Sprinkle the filler cheese down the middle, and put whatever toppings you want down the middle.
#Fold the shell over, and let it cook long enough to melt the filler cheese if desired.
#Serve and eat right away.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* It's advisable to get the toppings ready in advance—it's a time-critical procedure once the cheese is flipped.
